reference.title: Scenario 3: nested tables in a reference topic
reference.shortdesc: Consider a "Regional Data Center Configuration Matrix" chapter in a "Cloud Deployment Reference Guide" document

section.p: Consider a "Regional Data Center Configuration Matrix" chapter in a "Cloud Deployment Reference Guide" document where you want to show a parent table containing region-level information and a nested table inside one of the cells to display environment-specific endpoint mappings.
section.note:
When creating nested tables in DITA, place the child or inside a

element within the parent because the DITA content model does not allow tables as direct children of table cells.
section.codeblock:
Regional Data Center Configuration Matrix Regional deployments can contain multiple environment-specific endpoint configurations.

section.p: Result:Nested tables are properly formatted and are displayed accurately in any output.
